title: Admin 後台全面 redesign — UI 翻新 + 功能補強 + 多語支援
content: Admin 後台目前僅有 mock data（admin/page.tsx）與 enrolments 列表（admin/enrolments/page.tsx 已串真實 API）。本卡片進行全面翻新：(1) UI 重新設計，符合 institutional 設計系統；(2) 功能補強：Course CRUD、User 管理、Enrolment 搜尋/篩選/批次操作；(3) 全三語介面 (en/zh-hk/zh-cn)。

findings: admin/page.tsx uses mock data — needs real API integration
admin/enrolments/page.tsx has real API but minimal UI
No course management UI in admin yet (CM-001 has CRUD API, but no frontend)
No user management in admin yet
No i18n dictionary for admin pages exists
evidence.residual: Large scope — consider splitting into smaller task cards during implementation planning (AD-002 for UI, AD-003 for functionality, AD-004 for i18n). Requires product approval + UI mockup gate.

acceptance: UI: redesigned admin sidebar navigation (dashboard, enrolments, courses, users), consistent with design system tokens, breadcrumbs, responsive layout
Dashboard: real stats cards (total enrolments, pending approvals, course count, user count) fetched from API
Enrolments: advanced filtering (by status, course, date range), search by name/email/idDocNumber, batch approve/reject
Courses: CRUD table view — list all courses, edit course details, toggle registration status, create new course
Users: table of registered users — view details, search by name/email
i18n: all admin pages in en/zh-hk/zh-cn via dictionary system
Auth: only admin role users can access /admin/* routes (existing middleware)
Error handling: inline error messages for API failures, loading skeletons during data fetch
Empty states: meaningful empty state messages per section (e.g. 'No enrolments found')
files: src/components/admin/* (new — shared admin components: DataTable, AdminSidebar, StatCard, etc.)
verification: Visit /en/admin → real dashboard stats. Enrolments page shows real data with filters working. Course CRUD: create/edit/delete course. Users page lists all registered users. All pages work in zh-hk and zh-cn locales. Non-admin user redirected to 403/login.
